facts.text: John joined the fire-fighting brigade and expressed excitement about being involved in helping his community.

evidence.quote: Hey Maria! Guess what? I'm now part of the fire-fighting brigade. I'm super excited to be involved and help out my community!

facts.text: John described the fire-fighting brigade as dedicated and noted that being around them was inspiring.

evidence.quote: I was impressed with their dedication and how well they worked together. Just being around them was so inspiring!

facts.text: John mentioned that the fire-fighting brigade worked together for two hours and accomplished a significant task.

evidence.quote: It only took us two hours. We worked hard but did something good – it was really satisfying.

facts.text: Maria commented on the image of a group of people loading a truck with a fire truck in the back, noting the teamwork involved.

evidence.quote: That's amazing. Must have been awesome to see all those people working together.
